answer: Seed the grading stream with honeypots: planted answers that look ordinary but carry a known fatal flaw only a careful judge catches. Any identity approving one reveals it never evaluated — the tell of a farm cross-grading its fakes to fake quorum. Caught graders are slashed. An operator rubber-stamping a dune of personas to pass each other waves the canary through at the inlet to emission and exposes the ring. Honeypots look like real tasks yet are drawn unpredictably, so cheaters cannot filter them; an honest judge scoring a violet-clear bad answer as bad passes every time and pays nothing.
